label: desktop-critique-diagnostic
invocation: async (page) => { const b=page.locator(".critique button").first(); await b.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); await b.hover(); await page.waitForFunction(()=>Number(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".critique-popover")).opacity)>0.99); return await b.evaluate(b=>({active:b===document.activeElement,focusWithin:b.parentElement.matches(":focus-within"),hover:b.parentElement.matches(":hover"),style:{opacity:getComputedStyle(b.nextElementSibling).opacity,visibility:getComputedStyle(b.nextElementSibling).visibility,pointerEvents:getComputedStyle(b.nextElementSibling).pointerEvents},viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight]})); }
